name: Volkov-Saito Precision VS-40 'Magistrate'
description:
The Volkov-Saito VS-40 is a full-size semi-automatic pistol chambered in .40 S&W, designed for the licensed enforcement and upscale personal protection market. The frame is machined from a single billet of aerospace-grade aluminum, and the slide features a distinctive angular profile with forward cocking serrations. The trigger is a crisp single-action with a 1.8kg break weight.

Volkov-Saito markets the Magistrate to corponation security directors, licensed bounty enforcement agents, and wealthy individuals who want a sidearm that communicates authority without being ostentatious. The fit and finish are excellent — not decorative, but precisely crafted in a way that rewards close inspection. Every surface is functional, every angle deliberate.

The Magistrate has become the unofficial standard sidearm for mid-level corponation enforcement personnel who have enough rank to choose their own equipment but not enough to access military-grade smart-linked systems. It occupies a comfortable middle ground between the utilitarian Workhorse class and the high-tech weapons of the Spires.
specifications:
caliber: .40 S&W
effective_range: 50 meters
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic
magazine_capacity: 13 rounds
weight: 0.92 kg
tactical_use: A precision duty pistol with superior accuracy and ergonomics compared to budget-tier sidearms. The .40 S&W round provides better terminal performance against lightly armored targets than 9mm alternatives. Suitable for aimed fire in deliberate engagements. The single-action trigger rewards trained shooters.
cultural_context: Carrying a Magistrate signals that you are serious, professional, and solvent enough to spend ten times what a Workhorse costs. In Mid and upper-Mid circles, it is a status marker that says 'I handle my own security problems.' Corponation enforcement agents who carry them tend to maintain them meticulously.
story_hooks: A Magistrate with a unique serial number prefix keeps appearing at crime scenes across three districts — registered to a person who has been dead for two years.
A Volkov-Saito factory worker is smuggling out Magistrate frames with a hidden modification that no scanner has detected yet.
